title: When the Bell Sings
author: Emrys Dunmore
blurb: Sebastian Sandoval, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must get the family out ahead of the count before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
